metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for language, development, and investment

plugins.name: doc-util
plugins.description: A plugin for reading and searching various document formats including CHM files

plugins.name: korea-gov-data
plugins.description: Extract and organize Open API specifications from KOSIS (Korean Statistical Information Service)

plugins.name: dom-analyzer
plugins.description: HTML/XML DOM structure analysis toolkit with hierarchy visualization and CSS selector discovery

plugins.name: spectrack
plugins.description: Provider-backed workflow over GitHub Issues, Jira, GitHub repository wiki directory, and Confluence with issue and knowledge authoring contracts

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: PlantUML, D2, and Structurizr DSL diagram creation, syntax reference, validation, and rendering

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Project-configured reviewers, explicit Stop review choices with single-ID checkpoint tools, and Git diffs in Herdr.

plugins.name: handover
plugins.description: Write a self-contained session handover that a later session can resume. Recorded handovers are loaded after `/clear` in Claude Code.

plugins.name: agenda
plugins.description: A pane of what the session is discussing: the current topic and the open items, decisions marked. A hooks-module mod for Claude Code.

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Split and size delegated work, independently verify worker results, and learn from recorded verdicts.
